page.title: Teams
page.subtitle: Find a team that needs players, or start your own.

empty.title: We couldn't find any teams
empty.description: Try changing or clearing the filters, or start the first team yourself.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.description: We couldn't load the teams. Try again in a moment.

detail.recruitingAny: Send a request and the leader will see it.

new.title: Create your team
new.subtitle: Fill in the basics and open the team to new players whenever you like.

form.name: Team name
form.sportLockedHint: The sport can't be changed after the team is created.
form.sportTakenHint: You already have a team for: {sports}. You can have one team per sport.
form.recruitingHint: The team shows up in the filter for teams that are looking for players.

logo.hint: Optional. JPG, PNG or WebP, up to {{size}} MB.
logo.errorType: Pick a JPG, PNG or WebP image.
logo.errorSize: The image is larger than {{size}} MB.

join.login: Log in to send a request
join.leaveBody: You'll lose your spot and you'll need to send a new request to rejoin.
join.sportTaken: You already have a team in this sport
join.errorConflict: Something changed in the team. Refresh the page and try again.

manage.title: Team management
manage.requestsFull: The team is full. Raise the maximum number of members or remove someone to accept new requests.

confirm.transferBody: {name} will become the team leader and you will stay on as a regular member.
confirm.removeBody: {name} will leave the team and will need to send a new request to rejoin.
confirm.deleteBody: The team will be deleted permanently and you can't undo this.

manage.infoBody: Change the name, logo, level, area, description, maximum members and the "Looking for players" setting.
manage.leaveBody: To leave, transfer leadership to another member first. If you're the only member, you can delete the team.
manage.errorConflict: Something changed in the team. Refresh the page and try again.

booking.title: Book as
booking.note: Team members will be notified and will see the booking on the team page.
booking.hint: You only see teams you lead in the same sport.

split.title: Team shares
split.leaderNote: You paid {total}. Your own share is {share}.

splitPay.title: Pay your share
splitPay.refundNote: If the booking is cancelled, your share is returned to you.
